classes.name: Did not look
classes.definition: The bot acted without reading the source that held what the turn needed.
classes.include: No read of the needed source inside the turn.
classes.exclude: It read the source and then misused it.

classes.name: Brain result crossed scope
classes.definition: A brain search returned another member's private content and the bot used it.
classes.include: The leaked text came from a brain result.
classes.exclude: The leaked text came from a world read.

classes.name: Wrong figure
classes.definition: The bot read the right source and reported a different figure.
classes.include: The figure in the reply differs from the source.
classes.exclude: The source itself held the wrong figure.

classes.name: Grader defect
classes.definition: The grader failed a reply that met the task.
classes.include: The reply meets the task text and the grader rejects it.
classes.exclude: The reply misses part of the task.
